observation: OHCHR says fighting began at about 06:00
OHCHR says fighting resumed in the early morning
OHCHR reports installation of a projectile launcher
OHCHR estimates that the first projectile struck a civilian home at about 10:30
OHCHR estimates the church explosion at about 10:45; CNMH records about 11:00
A message summarized under July 25 dates a projectile impact in the storage area to July 24
Field team's report dates its arrival at the port to 06:00
Red Crescent compilation quotes an ICRC account of entry into a Turkish Cypriot area; subsequent firing has no separate clock
Parliamentary inquiry gives 16:00 for the ceasefire and describes reported activity continuing afterward
Vũ Ngự Chiêu dates an early phase of the attack to 04:00
Vũ Ngự Chiêu places the capture of the port shortly before the ceasefire
Veteran account published by Vietnam National Archives Center I dates the end of firing to early morning
